convention_rule: Assumed: the k-th of four identical objects lit green, counted left to right, marks the k-th candidate in the packet's listed (energy-ascending) order. No earlier examples were given.
basis: A: four benches, only the rightmost (4th) lit green. B: four picnic tables, only the rightmost (4th) lit green. Listed order P1,P4,P2,P3 makes the 4th P3, which is non-client-correct (P1 is). If counted in ID order, the 4th would be P4 instead.
